name: @storytree/ci-cd
description: The ci-cd story's own building (ADR-0192 packages-forward). It holds this story's PIPELINE judges — pure, dependency-free readers of `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — starting with `green-gate`'s static-YAML audit. Deliberately NOT the home of a `check:*` rung's analyser: `ci-cd` owns the pipeline, `cli` owns the judge a rung invokes (see stories/cli/gate-ci-parity.md).
